name: Minefield Probe (research)
description: Research only, for the Veterancy System's MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield. Logs whether the game credits the minefield's kills to it, and every MD-6 mine blast. In a mission, F7 switches off every other armed mine of your newest minefield (their units removed) to see whether the game's own mines can be taken away; the log says if a switched-off one still blew. F6 grows up to 6 blown mines of that field back in the game's own field, to see whether they go off again. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
